caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a triangular, metal frame with three short legs supporting it, and a wooden handle attached to one side. The frame has a pointed tip and rounded base, resembling the shape of a flat iron. Inside the triangular frame, five parallel, wavy metal rods extend from the pointed tip toward the handle, meeting a solid bar that is perpendicular to them near the handle end. The handle itself appears textured, indicating a wood grain pattern, and is attached to the metal frame with a visible joint. The drawing is rendered in black ink on a plain, light beige background, with simple line work and stippling used to indicate texture and depth. There are small spots visible on the background, suggesting aging or staining of the paper. The initials "B.W." appear in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Flatiron Holder
